description: Master asset provenance registry. One source of truth for every imported or generated asset (audio, music, voices, graphics, textures, 3D models, animations, fonts, video, other). Human-readable credits are GENERATED from this file by scripts/assets/registry.mjs — never edited by hand. Portable: no Replit-specific knowledge required.

creativeIdentity.rule: Original creative work is credited to Fractured Flow, never to a production tool. Tool/generation details are recorded internally in each entry for compliance only, unless a license legally requires player-facing attribution.
